headline: Exit-poll deadlock confirmed across outlets, reaction quotes in, NO CEC real-count seat figures published as of last check
dek: Exit polls (Kan 11, Channels 12, 13) project change bloc 52-53 seats vs Netanyahu bloc 50, Arab-led parties 17-18, Likud largest single party at 24-25, Yashar 21-23; neither bloc reaches the 61-seat majority. In-window additions: Eisenkot vowed to 'act immediately' to replace Netanyahu's…
sources: Kan 11 / Channel 12 / Channel 13 exit polls, as reported by Jerusalem Post, Ynetnews, TRT World, Al Jazeera, NPR/KNKX, The Times
fault_line: Can Eisenkot govern without the Arab parties (17-18 seats) whose support his own partners, notably Liberman, refused during the campaign -- or does the kingmaker math force a deal nobody campaigned on?
